messages:
jen-ops: Quick retro on last night's ingress surge — we saw a rapid spike in 5xx/timeouts across hosted inference. Opening notes and ask for owners for follow-ups.

sam-platform: Timeline looks like ~01:12 UTC start, sudden Conn count rise -> CB trips on several routes.

maria-support: ~150 customer reports came in, mostly timeouts then 502/503s. I've flagged the top 3 impacted accounts and their contact leads.

david-sre: Short summary from ops: auth-proxy experienced keepalive resets -> increased request latency to upstreams -> client SDKs retried aggressively -> queue blowout -> runtime worker exhaustion and 503s. Example log snippet:

```
ERROR auth-proxy: keepalive reset from 10.12.8.45 after 2s
WARN gateway: queue_length=1200 worker_free=2 route=/v1/generate -> circuit_open
```

replay-bot: Replayed traces for 1800 sample requests; 72% hit the auth-proxy timeout path that triggers our 502 fallback.

jen-ops: Mitigations we ran during the incident:
- widened circuit-breaker cooldowns briefly
- disabled passthrough of aggressive client retries at the gateway
- rerouted a portion of traffic to the Dedicated pool for affected customers
These stopped the error spike by ~01:35 UTC.

sam-platform: Root cause hypothesis: a combination of (A) SDK clients with tight retry windows and (B) short-lived keepalive resets from the edge LB causing auth proxy slowdowns. The retries amplify the transient auth delays.

maria-support: Customers are asking for a post-incident summary and whether they'll get credits. I'll draft the comms once we finalize impact window and SLA check.

david-sre: Action items proposal (please ack and take owners):
- increase circuit breaker per-route threshold from 50 -> 75 req/s (owner: david-sre, due: 2025-06-05)
- implement per-customer connection caps for hosted free tier (owner: sam-platform, due: 2025-06-12)
- instrument auth-proxy keepalive reset metric and alert (owner: lee-infra, due: 2025-06-02)
- add 5xx-rate alert (5xx% > 1% for 5m) tied to runbook (owner: david-sre, due: 2025-06-02)

lee-infra: On the auth-proxy fix — I have a small patch for keepalive handling in canary now. Plan to roll to prod tomorrow morning after one full canary pass. Also adding a `keepalive_reset_rate` metric + grafana panel.

jen-ops: Runbook updates: add explicit step to temporarily scale Dedicated pools and to “mute” gateway retries for 15m during an active cb event. Owner: jen-ops, due: 2025-06-03.

maria-support: Comms draft plan: short apology, timeline, concrete mitigations, and proposed credit (10% for impacted window). I'll loop in legal & finance. Aiming to share draft by EOD.

david-sre: Monitoring follow-ups: create synthetic probe that exercises keepalive behavior from multiple regions and alert on increased reset percent. Owner: david-sre, due: 2025-06-06.

sam-platform: Also propose an SDK/backoff review — default backoff in some clients is too aggressive for transient auth latency. Owner for coordination: maria-support to engage devx and SDK leads, due: 2025-06-08.

maria-support: Acked. I'll start the thread with devx and pull the affected SDK versions.

david-sre: I've created the postmortem doc stub (internal): https://redwood.internal/postmortem/1785551111 — I'll populate the minute-by-minute timeline and attach logs.

replay-bot: Saved 6 replay bundles under s3://replay/1785551111/ for deeper analysis.

jen-ops: Finance note — finance saw a cost bump from retry amplification. Maria please coordinate extracting cost delta for impacted customers and include in comms.

maria-support: Will pull cost snapshots and attach to the comms draft.

sam-platform: Quick ask: can infra add a temporary rate-limit rule that kicks in for noisy clients at the gateway to prevent fan-out until we ship longer-term caps?

lee-infra: Yes, we can add a short-term clamp rule scoped by customer-id header. I'll propose a safe default and share in infra channel. Owner: lee-infra, due: 2025-06-04.

jen-ops: Ok — close loop plan: owners above to update the incident board (/board/incidents/1785551111) with tasks + estimated ETA. We'll reconvene next Thursday for a 30-min follow-up to verify fixes. :thumbsup:

maria-support: Posting comms draft by EOD and adding customer list to the PM doc.

jen-ops: Thanks everyone. Please add any missed items to the thread.
